let cs := coneOfSection hs
exact ⟨t.lift cs ⟨⟩, fun j ↦ congr_fun (t.fac cs j) ⟨⟩,
  fun x hx ↦ congr_fun (t.uniq cs (fun _ ↦ x) fun j ↦ funext fun _ ↦ hx j) ⟨⟩⟩
